WHAT IS CONTINUE? An open-source AI coding assistant you can customize and build into your own developer workflow.

WHY IT'S USEFUL? Fully open-source | Highly customizable | Works with your own models (OpenAI, local LLMs, etc.) | Can be integrated into IDEs like VSCode | Great starting point to build your own AI developer tool.
HOW IT WORKS? YOUR CODE → AI ASSISTANT: Write, editor chat | Customizable | Get code suggestions, explanations and more.
KEY TAKEAWAY: BUILD YOUR OWN AI CODING ASSISTANT. Customize the experience instead of starting from scratch.
WHAT IS ROO CODE? An open-source AI coding agent designed to work inside your code editor and handle coding tasks through different specialized modes.
ONE TOOL, DIFFERENT MODES: RooCode comes with multiple modes to help you with different tasks. CODE MODE, ARCHITECT MODE, ASK MODE, DEBUG MODE.
WHAT IS CLINE? An open-source coding agent that can understand your project, edit files, run terminal commands, and help you complete coding tasks step-by-step.
YOUR TASK → WORKING → PROJECT: Give it a goal or describe what you want to build. Plans→Reads→Codes→Runs in your codebase with your approval.
WHY IT STANDS OUT? EDITS CODE, RUNS COMMANDS, YOU STAY IN CONTROL: Can create/modify files, execute terminal commands, and respond to your output.
WHAT IS OPENHANDS? An open-source platform for AI-driven software development that lets coding agents work on real development tasks.
KEY FEATURES: WORKS ON CODE, RUNS TOOLS, MULTI-AGENT SUPPORT, SELF-HOSTABLE. Can modify projects, interact with environments, and work with compatible agents.
WHAT IS AIDER? An open-source AI pair-programming tool that works directly with your codebase from the terminal.
